name: Marc E. Hankin
tagline: Top rated Intellectual Property Litigation attorney in Los Angeles, California
about: Marc E. Hankin is the founding partner of HPL Intellectual Property Law, a leading law firm based in Los Angeles, California. Currently serving as the managing partner of the firm, he established it in 2004 with the objective of providing comprehensive legal counsel to businesses of all sizes, focusing on safeguarding their valuable technology and creative works. With over a quarter of a century of legal experience, he is a seasoned attorney known for his proficiency in patent prosecution, copyright registration, trademark registration, licensing agreements and related intellectual property matters.

Before founding HPL Intellectual Property Law, Mr. Hankin served as a partner at several prestigious law firms, gaining extensive experience in advising clients across various industries, including media, optical, dental, medical devices, footwear, textiles, food and nutraceuticals. His broad knowledge spans mechanical, chemical and electrical arts, enabling him to offer comprehensive legal solutions tailored to each client's unique needs.

Mr. Hankin is a registered patent attorney with a strong science background, and his legal practice encompasses all aspects of licensing and litigation in intellectual property law. He has successfully litigated cases involving patent, trademark, and copyright infringements, as well as domain name disputes, thefts of trade secrets and unfair competition. He has represented a wide range of clients, from solo inventors and startups to Fortune 500 companies and educational institutions, in complex business litigation and intellectual property disputes.

Recognized for his legal acumen and dedication to his clients, Mr. Hankin has received numerous accolades throughout his career. Highly active in professional organizations, he has served in leadership roles in various legal associations, including The Howard T. Markey Intellectual Property American Inn of Court and the Los Angeles Intellectual Property Law Association.

Mr. Hankin earned his Bachelor of Science degree from Boston University, a Master of Science degree from Iona College, and his Juris Doctor from the University of Pennsylvania Law School. He is admitted to practice before the state and federal bars of California and New Jersey, as well as multiple federal district and appellate courts across the United States.
